property_summary: For every caller and sent Ether amount, calling withdrawAll after funding the contract never decreases the contract balance when invoked by the owner (reference) — the mutant removing onlyOwner allows a non-owner caller to withdraw and thus can make address(c).balance smaller for some inputs.
change_summary: Modified onlyOwner to be permissive (no check), allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and change observed post-call balance.
